facts.fact: Streaming hours surge by 17% during holiday downtime, according to a Roku source cited by Universal Ads.
facts.quote: Streaming hours surge by 17% during holiday downtime,1

facts.fact: Nearly 60% of viewers say CTV ads help drive their holiday buying decisions, according to an LG Ads source cited by Universal Ads.
facts.quote: nearly 60% of viewers say CTV ads help drive their holiday buying decisions.2

facts.fact: 36% of consumers get gift ideas from TV, per a source cited by Universal Ads.
facts.quote: 36% of consumers get gift ideas from TV

facts.fact: Universal Ads states advertisers have about one month to build familiarity before consumers start checking out ahead of Black Friday and peak shopping season.
facts.quote: advertisers have about a month to build familiarity before consumers start checking out.

facts.fact: Universal Ads says Google Trends data over the past 3 years shows gift-related searches start climbing in October.
facts.quote: Google trends spanning the past 3 years show gift-related searches start climbing in October

facts.fact: The Google Trends data behind the gift-search claim covers the keyword 'Christmas gifts' for Sep 2022 to Jan 2025.
facts.quote: Google trends data for keyword “Christmas gifts.” Sep 2022-Jan 2025.

facts.fact: In a Comcast Advertising consumer survey conducted by Dynata, 78% of people say they typically buy the same brands over and over again when shopping.
facts.quote: say they typically buy the same brands over and over again when they’re shopping.

facts.fact: The Comcast Advertising survey conducted by Dynata in March 2025 had a sample size of 1,507 respondents.
facts.quote: Comcast Advertising consumer survey conducted by Dynata. March 2025, n=1507.

facts.fact: Citing VAB research, new-to-TV brands see up to a 42% lift in website conversions.
facts.quote: new-to-TV brands see up to a 42% lift in website conversions
